family_selection.eligible: candidate must pass the frozen competence contract
family_selection.method: Pareto filtering followed by deterministic lexicographic tie-break
family_selection.incumbent_protection: select incumbent when challenger is ineligible or fails to strictly improve before the final candidate-id tie-break

primary_traditional.eligible: all three frozen family winners are considered if competent
primary_traditional.rule: same Pareto and lexicographic order as family selection

satc_qualification: competence PASS; safety and per-family success not below Primary Traditional; >=5% improvement in at least one registered core metric; zero catastrophic regression; <=5% RMSE regression in the other task family
